report:
Fresh review of the complete fixtures claim (including its grammar examples), eight ordinary implementation entries and thirteen associated ordinary tests. No TODO/N/A entries are attached. Read captured source and all test bodies, and captured item dispatch as the additional module-demand dependency. No source edits, build or tests executed in this source-only review.

Grammar and root: compile/mod.rs compile_test accepts comma-separated fields in any order, a literal-path files map with expression values, and optional trailing commas. Expressions are evaluated at the caller and converted to source strings. source delegates to files with src/lib.rs. Builder setters reject duplicate source/files, edition and expectation fields; prepare rejects missing source/files. Unknown fields become invalid method calls; no root selector exists. validate_files requires src/lib.rs and rejects duplicates, absolute or backslash paths, empty/dot/parent components, reserved Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock/root build.rs/.cargo configuration paths, and any file that is an ancestor directory of another entry. Materialization creates directories under a new temporary project and emits the generated manifest. rustc.rs independently invokes src/lib.rs, and host driver selects the generated package's normal library target, so no alternate root is inferred.

Loading semantics and all remaining implementation entries: sage-host driver registers textual package files regardless of extension, with normalized root-relative inputs including leading parent components for files outside src; registration does not itself parse them as modules. source.rs provides that normalization. local_syms/mods.rs distinguishes file-backed and inline module bodies and parses file contents only when module items are demanded. parse/items.rs resolves implicit modules against exactly child.rs and child/mod.rs and returns an error item when neither or both exist; a recognized explicit path bypasses that candidate search. It composes enclosing inline module directories, including explicit inline directory overrides, and normalizes explicit relative paths. parse/attrs.rs extracts supported ordinary path string attributes; unsupported spellings remain active and cannot silently select an alternate file. The captured parser dispatcher invokes module parsing from actual declarations. observe.rs walks the selected root's semantic modules, records reached source files, and rejects any annotation whose file is absent from that set. Unreferenced registered files are therefore not implicitly compiled, while their annotations fail rather than being ignored. The standalone rustc compiler operates on the same materialized tree and module declarations.

All thirteen tests accounted for: rejects_ambiguous_or_escaping_files asserts errors for missing root, every listed reserved configuration class, duplicate root, parent traversal, absolute path and file/directory collision. unused_file_annotations_fail requires the selected-crate error for an annotation in an unreferenced file. modules_and_associated_bodies asserts an observation inside src/nested/mod.rs. source_expressions_field_order_and_optional_trailing_commas exercises reordered fields, indoc/raw/ordinary/String expressions, optional commas and nested file declarations. source_selection_and_duplicate_fields_are_rejected checks missing input, both source/files orders, duplicate maps/source and every configurable duplicate field against specific panic messages. unknown_field_and_root_selection_fail_to_compile builds a temporary downstream package and requires compiler failure mentioning the absent method for both an unknown name and root; unrelated build failure cannot satisfy that message assertion. ambiguous_module_files_are_not_silently_selected requires failure when both implicit candidates exist. explicit_module_path_selects_one_of_two_candidate_files asserts the selected file's type snapshot while the other file contains an invalid body, concretely testing both explicit selection and lack of implicit checking. explicit_module_path_accepts_non_rs_source_filename and explicit_module_path_can_reach_fixture_file_outside_src exercise extension-independent and parent-relative module references while keeping fixture map keys valid. explicit_module_path_in_inline_module_uses_inline_directory and explicit_path_on_inline_module_controls_child_directory cover both ordinary inline nesting and overridden directories. Those four tests carry expected rustc warnings in the selected files, and the harness's checked-files annotation gate requires Sage to reach them too. path_attribute_inside_inline_module_uses_its_module_directory additionally asserts a Sage type observation in the renamed nested file. These tests jointly establish grammar, errors, materialized directories, fixed root, demanded module membership and explicit selection. No concrete defect or requested edit found in the reviewed fixture contract.
